## 2. Core Service Offerings & Specializations

### A. 3D Web Design & Frontend Engineering
- Bespoke 3D web experiences and interactive storytelling.
- Tech Stack: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, WebGL/Three.js.
- Features: Overlapping card stack animations, continuous infinite marquees, magnet cursor interactions, 3D flip page-turn transitions, dark luxury aesthetic.
- Performance: Mobile-first responsive optimization, zero layout shift, sub-second TTFB, 95+ Google Lighthouse scores.

### B. Luxury Branding & Identity Architecture
- Comprehensive brand identity development for premium businesses, studios, luxury fashion, and hospitality.
- Visual systems: Logo marks, custom typography, luxury color palettes (charcoal black `#0C0C0C`, metallic silver `#D7E2EA`, luminous magenta `#B600A8`), brand style guidelines.
- Social media design kits, marketing collateral, business cards, and packaging mockups.

### C. Digital Wedding & Event Invitations
- Interactive digital web invitations replacing traditional paper cards.
- Embedded love story timelines, interactive RSVP forms with direct WhatsApp / Google Sheets connectivity, Google Maps location integration, music background players, countdown timers, and event galleries.
- Successfully deployed for high-profile weddings and sacred milestone events in India and internationally.

### D. Digital Lookbooks & Fashion Studio Portfolios
- Haute couture and boutique design studio websites with editorial magazine layouts.
- Dynamic collection galleries, lookbooks, bespoke appointment booking, and direct customer inquiry channels.

### E. Commercial Photography & Film Media Portfolios
- Ultra-high-resolution photo & video presentation portals for commercial photographers, cinematographers, and creative agencies.
- Fullscreen media display, masonry grid layouts, and lightbox experiences.

### F. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & Advanced SEO
- Next-generation search engine optimization focused on both traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and AI search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Google AI Overviews).
- Schema.org JSON-LD structured data implementation (ProfessionalService, LocalBusiness, ItemList, FAQPage, Organization).
- Fast load speed optimization, semantic HTML5, canonical URL hierarchy, and `llms.txt` integration.

**Q: Where is Ebenora Creations located?**
